name: cirrus-mail
description: A self-hosted email suite that runs entirely on your own Cloudflare account. Email Routing in, Email Sending out, D1 + R2 storage, and a fast web client.

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --check 2>/dev/null; tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:migrate:remote: CI=true wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build && (npm run db:migrate:remote || echo "D1 not provisioned yet (first deploy); migrating after deploy") && node scripts/check-migrations.mjs && wrangler deploy && npm run db:migrate:remote

SETUP_TOKEN.description: One-time token you type on the first-run setup screen to create the admin account. Pick any long random string.

APP_SECRET.description: Random secret (32+ chars) used to sign attachment and image-proxy URLs.
